senses: having given surety, liable to be called to account
grc:adj:ὑπέγγυος.html:
ὑπέγγυος, ον,
under surety:
of persons, having given surety, liable to be called to account or punished, (lyr.); ὑ. πλὴν θανάτουliable to any punishment short of death, : c. dat., γὸ γὰρ ὑπέγγυον δίκᾳ καὶ θεοῖσινliability to human and divine justice, (lyr.).
of things, legitimate,γάμος ὑ., opp. ἀνέγγυος, .
pledged, hypothecated, (i B. C.), (ii A. D.).
